value.rationale: Complete Vietoris–Rips filtrations are a stated target in the owning literature for highly structured finite metric spaces. The Dürer graph is a named 12-vertex cubic polyhedral generalized Petersen graph, and the exact transition from a five-circle wedge to a 2-sphere and then to contractibility at threshold 3 gives a compact benchmark beyond the Platonic cases. The claim is the full filtration, not an arbitrary isolated Betti number or a routine recomputation of a known table.
